description: This file defines a PHP class 'LogNormal' for calculating various statistical distributions related to the lognormal distribution, including cumulative distribution, probability density function, and inverse distribution. It contains methods for these calculations, handles array inputs, and references other classes for validation and calculations.

classes.name: LogNormal
classes.description: A class providing static methods for calculating lognormal distribution functions, including cumulative distribution, probability density, and inverse distribution value, with array handling and validation.

methods.name: cumulative
methods.description: Calculates the cumulative lognormal distribution for a given value, mean, and standard deviation.

methods.name: distribution
methods.description: Calculates either the probability density function or cumulative distribution function of the lognormal distribution based on input parameter.

methods.name: inverse
methods.description: Calculates the inverse of the lognormal cumulative distribution (quantile function) for a given probability, mean, and standard deviation.
